verdict.rationale: Stripe's core resources (payments, refunds, subscriptions, invoices, disputes, payouts, tax, Connect) are all documented as available via the REST API with idempotency, versioning, and restricted keys, and the MCP server explicitly exposes generic stripe_api_read/stripe_api_write tools plus task-specific tools mirroring Dashboard actions across most objects. Workbench Shell/CLI further lets agents run the same commands as the CLI/API interactively. missing for 10: independent confirmation that every Dashboard-only feature (e.g., third-party Stripe Apps like Kyber no-code automations) has a full API equivalent, and note that sensitive stripe_api_write actions require human confirmation rather than being fully autonomous.
